title: Vegan Loaded Jacket Sweet Potatoes
subtitle: with Sweet Chilli Tofu and 'Sour Cream'
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you’re vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Roast sweet potatoes: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Halve the unpeeled sweet potatoes lengthwise. Put the sweet potatoes on the lined tray, drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper and turn to coat. Turn the sweet potatoes cut-side down and roast for 25-30 mins until tender.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, shred the carrot using a julienne peeler or coarsely grate with a box grater. Cut the tofu into 2cm cubes. Add half the sesame seeds to the vegan sour cream and stir to combine.
Toss salad: Combine 2 tsp olive oil and 1 tsp white wine vinegar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the carrot and salad leaves and toss to combine.
Warm tofu: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden and warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Divide the salad and jacket sweet potatoes among plates. Top the sweet potatoes with the tofu and sesame 'sour cream'. Scatter over the remaining sesame seeds and enjoy!
Make it yours: Add a kick with a drizzle of chilli sauce or boost the freshness with a scattering of coriander leaves or thinly sliced spring onion, if you have some on hand.
